CHARTER PROFILE (About the End User Company)

Global Traveler is a travel magazine and website for frequent business and luxury travelers. It covers destinations, airlines, hotels and travel experiences, and publishes reader surveys and awards recognizing travel brands.

1 and 2 November are public holidays in parts of the region, so we need to check Sunday and holiday opening hours.
Tue 3 Nov  would be a sailing day. A chef-led chocolate and beer pairing and a Dutch versus Belgian cheese tasting would be good here coupled with wines from the regio.
Kinderdijk and Delta Works visitor access runs on reduced off-season hours, and the Gouda and Alkmaar cheese markets are closed in November.
Sunset is around 5 pm, so outdoor highlights such as Kinderdijk, Veere, and Damme should be scheduled in the morning or early afternoon.
